_comment: Configuration file for CVE prioritization scoring weights
_description: Adjust these weights to customize your prioritization strategy

scoring_weights._cvss_weight_description: Multiplier for CVSS base score (0-10). Default: 10 -> max 100 points
scoring_weights._expert_rating_weight_description: Multiplier for CrowdStrike Expert Rating (0-100). Default: 80 -> max 80 points. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED to keep this high as it incorporates CTI analysis.
scoring_weights._exploit_status_weight_description: Points per exploit status level (0-4). Default: 30 -> max 120 points
scoring_weights._asset_criticality_weight_description: Bonus points for critical assets. Default: 50 -> max 100 points
scoring_weights._age_weight_description: Points per day since publication. Default: 0.1

filtering._severities_description: Severity levels to include (remove to filter out)

examples._description: Example configurations for different prioritization strategies

aggressive._description: Focus heavily on exploited CVEs, expert ratings, and critical assets

balanced._description: Balanced approach with strong expert rating influence (default)

exposure_focused._description: Prioritize vulnerabilities affecting many hosts, still respect expert ratings

severity_only._description: Traditional CVSS-based prioritization with minimal expert rating influence

cti_driven._description: Maximum weight on CrowdStrike CTI (Expert Rating and Exploitation Status)
